about: App and browser control scenarios for tools/eval-control.py (T-144): real agent turns on the R1. Food orders are dry runs: built up to the add-to-cart button, never added, ordered or paid. Nothing plays sound.

suffix.dry: (This is a test run: build it all the way up to the add-to-cart button, but don't add it to the cart or order anything. Then tell me exactly what you'd add, every choice you made, and the price on the screen.)

dry: partway|part of the way|got stuck|gave up

scenarios.name: Wikipedia fact
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser, not WebSearch or WebFetch: go to en.wikipedia.org, search for Rabbit R1, and tell me the year it came out.

scenarios.name: Fill a form
scenarios.task: In the R1's browser (not WebFetch), open https://httpbin.org/forms/post and fill it in: customer name Max Bridgland, telephone 555-0100, email max@example.com, pizza size Medium, toppings Bacon and Extra Cheese, delivery time 19:30, comments: ring twice. Don't submit it, and leave the browser open; tell me when it's filled in.

scenarios.name: Python release
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser (not WebSearch or WebFetch) to open python.org and tell me the latest Python 3 release its Downloads page offers.

scenarios.name: Weather search box
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser (not WebSearch or WebFetch): on forecast.weather.gov, look up Boston, MA with its search box and tell me tonight's low.

scenarios.name: Spotify artist
scenarios.task: In Spotify in the app window, search for Fontaines D.C. and tell me their three most popular songs from the artist page.
expect: Starburster|Favourite|Jackie Down the Line|Here's the Thing|In the Modern World|Bug|Boys in the Better Land|Roman Holiday|Big Shot

scenarios.name: Spotify album
scenarios.task: In Spotify in the app window, find the album Romance by Fontaines D.C. and tell me how many songs are on it.

scenarios.name: Spotify library
scenarios.task: In Spotify in the app window, open my Liked Songs and tell me the first three songs in it.

scenarios.name: Big Mac meal (Max's)
scenarios.task: Order me a Big Mac meal, medium, with a Coke from McDonald's on Uber Eats.

scenarios.name: Complicated sandwich
scenarios.task: On Uber Eats, build me a footlong from Subway: turkey on Italian Herbs & Cheese bread, toasted, with provolone, lettuce, tomatoes, red onions and banana peppers, no mayo, extra mustard.

scenarios.name: Burrito bowl
scenarios.task: From Chipotle on Uber Eats, build a burrito bowl: double chicken, white rice, black beans, fajita veggies, mild salsa, corn salsa, cheese, lettuce, and guacamole on the side.

scenarios.name: Best pizza (open-ended)
scenarios.task: Find me the best-rated pizza place on Uber Eats that delivers in under 30 minutes, and pick something good from its menu for under $20.

scenarios.name: Cheap and filling (open-ended)
scenarios.task: I want something cheap and filling for dinner from Uber Eats, under $15 including the delivery fee. Compare a few places and pick for me.

scenarios.name: Compare across pages
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser (not WebSearch or WebFetch): on Wikipedia, find the populations of Malden, Medford and Everett in Massachusetts, and tell me which is largest and by how much.

scenarios.name: Recipe with constraints
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser (not WebSearch or WebFetch) to find a pizza dough or pizza recipe on allrecipes.com rated at least 4.5 stars that takes under an hour in total. Tell me its name, rating and total time.

scenarios.name: Multi-item with changes
scenarios.task: On Uber Eats, from McDonald's: two McDoubles, one of them with no pickles, a 10-piece Chicken McNuggets with sweet 'n sour sauce, and a large fries.

scenarios.name: Fussy coffee
scenarios.task: On Uber Eats, from Starbucks: a grande iced caramel macchiato with oat milk, an extra shot, light ice, and sugar-free vanilla syrup instead of the regular vanilla, plus a butter croissant, warmed.

scenarios.name: Constraints (open-ended)
scenarios.task: I'm vegetarian and want something high in protein for under $20, delivered in under 40 minutes, from Uber Eats. Find the best option you can and build it.

scenarios.name: Who came first
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser (not WebSearch or WebFetch): on Wikipedia, find out which of Ada Lovelace, Charles Babbage and Alan Turing was born first, and give all three birth years.

scenarios.name: Hacker News now
scenarios.task: Use the R1's browser (not WebSearch or WebFetch): open news.ycombinator.com and tell me the title of the top story right now, how many points it has, and how many comments.

scenarios.name: Dunkin' breakfast
scenarios.task: On Uber Eats, from Dunkin': a large hot coffee with cream and two sugars, a Boston Kreme donut, and a bacon, egg and cheese on an everything bagel.

scenarios.name: Cheaper of two stores (open-ended)
scenarios.task: On Uber Eats, a 10-piece Chicken McNuggets can cost different amounts at different McDonald's. Check two nearby McDonald's, tell me the price at each, and build it at the cheaper one with barbecue sauce.
